title: These Cities Have the Most Ghost Sightings in Maine
excerpt: Maine ranks sixth most haunted per person in America, with Sanford leading the state in ghost sightings.
content:
Okay, Maine friends, I have a question. Have you ever been sitting in your house, minding your own business, when you hear a noise upstairs and suddenly decide you absolutely do NOT need to know what that was? Yeah. Same. 

Well, just in time for Halloween, we've got another reason to keep the lights on.

A new ranking from search-data company Answer Socrates puts Maine at the sixth most haunted state in America per person, with a spooky score of 73 out of 100. 

Maine Ranks Among the Most Haunted States in America

And apparently, we're not just making this stuff up in our heads. Maine reportedly has the most ghost sightings per person in the country, with 811 reader-submitted sightings.

We also have 2,998 cemeteries, ranking fourth per person. So, there's that. 

My thoughts are that basically, we're surrounded by places where ghosts could hang out. How wonderful!  And get this, do you want to know where Maine's ghost activity is supposedly happening?

Well, Sanford takes the top spot, with 27 reported sightings, followed by Auburn and Bangor.

And here's my favorite part: Maine ranks second in the country for Googling cryptids, those mysterious creatures like Bigfoot.

Even Google seems to think we're a little spooky, with searches about why Maine is so haunted pointing people toward Portland, Bangor, and Derry and yes, that the fictional town made famous by Stephen King. 

Read More: Must Visit Haunted Attractions in New England

The ranking is based on reported sightings, cemeteries, spooky locations, and search trends. It doesn't prove ghosts are real, obviously… but it certainly gives us something to think about. 

So tell me: Have you ever experienced something you absolutely cannot explain here in Maine? I'm listening. Just please don't tell me your story right before I go to bed, deal?
